About me
I started out on the phones at a small web shop and slowly moved into marketing. These days I mostly run the newsletter and the paid search budget for a garden centre chain, and I organise our spring and Christmas campaigns.

Experience
2021 - now  Online marketeer, Groen & Co garden centres, Rotterdam
- Run Google Ads for 14 shops, about EUR 9k a month
- Weekly newsletter (38k subscribers); moved us from Mailchimp to Klaviyo in 2023
- Photos and short videos for Instagram, mostly shot on my phone in the shops
- Christmas 2023 webshop orders went from 2,140 to 2,610, partly because we finally fixed the checkout on mobile

2018 - 2021  Customer service, Tuinwinkel Online, Delft
Answered mail and phone, handled returns. Wrote the FAQ pages because nobody else wanted to.
Learnt a bit of HTML along the way.
